articles.summary: Infinity Natural Resources, Inc. (“Infinity” or the “Company”) (NYSE: INR) today reported its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results and narrowed its 2026 guidance. Third Quarter 2026 Results and Recent Highlights Delivered record net daily production of 431.7 MMcfe/d, a 100% increase compared to the third quarter 2025 104% increase in natural gas net production to 282.6 MMcf/d 79% increase in oil net production to 14.0 Mbbls/d Inclusive of $63.2 million of mark-to-market hedge losse
articles.title: Infinity Natural Resources Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results and Updates 2026 Guidance
